# Farmgenie Fresh Cart (FFC)

Offline Flutter Material 3 employee UI demo. Includes splash, validated mock login, Home, Profile, and logout confirmation. All five future modules are explicitly marked Coming Soon and are noninteractive.

## Demo login
Enter any nonblank username and password. This is not real authentication or a security boundary. Remember Me retains only the username in memory for this app process, including after logout. Passwords are cleared on login and never persisted. Restarting the process clears the remembered username. Employee details are fictional and consistent across screens.

Logout replaces the authenticated widget tree; Cancel leaves the current tab and session intact. There are no authenticated routes left to reopen using Back.

## Structure
- lib/theme: centralized Material 3 theme and brand colors
- lib/widgets: reusable logo, page layout, cards, inputs, buttons, employee details
- lib/models: immutable employee and fictional data
- lib/services: isolated mock session controller
- lib/screens: splash, login, dashboard, profile, and bottom navigation shell
- assets/images/farmgenie_logo.png: unchanged copy of the supplied official logo
- test/widget_test.dart: session, validation, password visibility, login, navigation, logout, back navigation, and responsive layout checks

No runtime packages beyond the Flutter SDK. No networking, ERPNext, database, camera, POS, or operational module implementations. Future authentication can replace the mock session service.

## Windows PowerShell commands
Open this folder in VS Code, or run:

```powershell
Set-Location 'I:\Farmgenie APP'
$env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Users\sathe\development\jdk21'
$env:ANDROID_HOME = 'C:\Users\sathe\development\android-sdk'
$env:ANDROID_USER_HOME = 'C:\Users\sathe\.android'
$env:Path = "$env:JAVA_HOME\bin;$env:Path"
$flutter = 'C:\Users\sathe\development\flutter\bin\flutter.bat'
$dart = 'C:\Users\sathe\development\flutter\bin\cache\dart-sdk\bin\dart.exe'
& $flutter pub get
& $dart format lib test
& $flutter analyze
& $flutter test
& $flutter devices
& $flutter run -d 094243134J013800
& $flutter build apk --debug
```

Verify the device ID with flutter devices; the previously connected phone is Infinix X6815C (Android 13). USB debugging must be authorized.

Debug APK: build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk

Install and launch without removing other apps or data:

```powershell
$adb = 'C:\Users\sathe\development\android-sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'
& $adb -s 094243134J013800 install -r 'build\app\outputs\flutter-apk\app-debug.apk'
& $adb -s 094243134J013800 shell am start -n 'com.example.farmgenie_fresh_cart/.MainActivity'
```

The Android application ID is com.example.farmgenie_fresh_cart; the Dart package is farmgenie_fresh_cart. Use a production organization ID and real authentication before any future production release.
